messages:
Ava (growth): Quick sync — want to lock the benchmark narrative for the launch post and webinar. focusing on latency vs $/token, but we need a compelling single line hook.
Jonah (design): Love the 3-panel visual idea (latency, cost, quality). Can we make the middle panel interactive for the webinar? simple slider showing tradeoffs.
Priya (analytics): Data check: we have per-model median latency and token cost for our top 5 models across short(64), medium(512), long(2048) contexts. I'll pull CSV in a min.
Marta (product): Goal: customers should walk away with 2 things — 1) predictable latency at scale, 2) knobs to control unit economics. Hook should reflect that.
Samir (ops): Ops note: emphasize dedicated vs hosted fallbacks — routing policy reduces 95p latency by ~30% in our sim. worth a callout.
Ava (growth): Draft hooks: a) "Same latency at 10x scale" b) "Cut inference spend without sacrificing responsiveness" — which leans latency-first vs cost-first. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Jonah (design): Both are fine but test both. For social we should short-copy: "Latency you can rely on. Dollars you can control."
Priya (analytics): Quick A/B plan: send two versions of the landing CTA to a small traffic cohort during webinar signups. Track signups and demo requests. Also capture 'latency importance' checkbox on signup to segment leads.
Marta (product): Love the segmentation idea. Add an inbound routing rule: if "latency important"==true -> route to SDRs with dedicated-capability pitch; else -> growth nurture with cost-econ content.
Samir (ops): Routing rule is doable. Suggest threshold: if customer expects < 100ms median at 512 tokens, tag as "latency-tier". We can add this to the signup form or infer from use case free text.
Priya (analytics): I'll prepare the signups dashboard and a UTM tag set: utm_campaign=bench_launch_v1_latency and _cost. Also provide baseline conversion rates for benchmarking.
Jonah (design): For the webinar demo: interactive slider code snippet idea shown to engineer — simple client side: 
```
// pseudo
renderSlider(onChange=(latencyWeight)=>updateChart(latencyWeight))
```
keep it lightweight.
Ava (growth): Copy asks: 1) blog post lead — "Why latency still wins" 2) webinar — demo + QA 3) one-pager for sales with two pitch templates (latency-first, cost-first). Who owns drafts?
Marta (product): I'll do the one-pager (sales templates). Ava you take the blog draft, Jonah design assets, Priya dashboard + A/B metrics, Samir infra bullet points.
Ava (growth): Great. Timeline? blog draft by Tue, webinar outline + demo by Thu, sales one-pager by Fri.
Priya (analytics): I can have the signup dashboard and initial UTM results by Mon after the soft test.
Samir (ops): I'll drop a short blurb on routing and fallback policy for the one-pager. Also will attach the sim numbers.
Jonah (design): I'll mock the 3-panel visual and the slider interaction frames by Wed EOD.
Ava (growth): Final: webinar hook line candidates — keep both but prioritize latency-first in paid channels. We'll test cost-first in organic channels. :rocket:
LaunchBot: Reminder: webinar registration form created at 1748123500. RSVP count: 0 -> 0. (auto)
Ava (growth): Thanks all — I'll start the blog outline now and post a draft link when ready.
Marta (product): One more ask: include a short customer quote about predictability (real or staged) — helps credibility.
Ava (growth): I'll pull a quote from the pilot customers list.
Priya (analytics): Uploading CSV of model latencies + token costs to the shared drive: https://drive.mock/redwood/benchmarks/latency_cost_top5.csv
Samir (ops): Noted. I'll validate the simulation numbers before we publish.
Ava (growth): perfect. meeting adjourned — thanks! :party_parrot:
